The '''LBR-9 stun rifle''' was a model of light-framed [[Stun blaster/Legends|stun blaster]] made by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] and made available for 2800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Based on the [[Firespray DL-87 stun rifle]] produced at the same time, the rifle used most of the same firing systems but had an optimised and upgraded galven pattern added to fit the LBR-9's longer barrel. Fitted with composite furniture and iron sights, the rifle used a patented mix of [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gases]] which, combined with the galven pattern, gave it enough strength to knock out most targets in one or two concentrated, high-precision bolts. The rifle had long range and accuracy comparable to most lethal weapons of the same weapon class as it. The rifles were mainly used by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and few were found in the fringe regions of the galaxy during the Civil War. Those that did make their way out of the Core were quickly purchased by either [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] or [[Big game hunter/Legends|big-game hunters]], who favored their non-lethal nature, precise handling and reputation for being finely made, dependable and accurate.<ref name="ETU" />

==Behind the scenes==
The LBR-9 was first mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Sterling Hershey]] and released in [[2013]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]] roleplaying game.
